name: Deaths for Her
source:
Diana Hoppers was on her way to college. But when passing through a mysterious ghost town on the way her car suddenly breaks down. She attempts to look for anyone who might be able to help her but suddenly falls unconscious.

Now she's in a seemingly normal room that she can't seem to escape from. Now, with the help of odd clues around the house, she must solve the messages left by an unknown entity to escape from her captor's grasp.

[From [url=https://cluelessjaja.itch.io/deaths-for-her-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黛安娜·霍珀斯原本正在去大学的路上，但在途经一座神秘的鬼镇时，她的车突然抛锚了。她试图四处寻找能帮上忙的人，却突然失去了意识。

醒来后，她发现自己身处一间看似正常却无法逃离的房间。如今，她必须借助屋里各处古怪的线索，解开某个未知存在留下的讯息，从而逃脱绑架者的魔掌。

[引自[url=https://cluelessjaja.itch.io/deaths-for-her-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
